nodes.label: Account-Generation Ownership Fence
nodes.rationale: Owner and generation scoping prevent cross-account or stale-generation application.

nodes.label: Background Account Preference Mirror
nodes.rationale: The account value mirrors the browser choice without overriding an explicit local revision.

nodes.label: Bounded-by-Shape Outbox
nodes.rationale: Pending work coalesces by logical session into terminal and latest slots.

nodes.label: Direct Active-Page Preference Application
nodes.rationale: The active page applies the local choice and resamples without reload or server response.

nodes.label: YouTube Meaningful-Progress Gate
nodes.rationale: Eligible playback requires actual advancement or ended on a supported long-form watch page.

nodes.label: Opt-Out Outbox Handoff
nodes.rationale: Opt-out clears active presentation, retains the last meaningful solo sample, and captures nothing afterward.

nodes.label: Local Preference Revision Fence
nodes.rationale: A newer local choice fences stale startup and account-refresh results.

nodes.label: YouTube Local-First Preference
nodes.rationale: YouTube history is an explicit browser-local opt-in, off by default.

nodes.label: Owner and Account-Generation Safety
nodes.rationale: Late responses apply only to the matching owner and generation.

nodes.label: Active Controller Preference Revision Subscription
nodes.rationale: Active controllers apply the exact local authority and sample immediately.

nodes.label: Terminal-Plus-Latest Account-Scoped Outbox
nodes.rationale: Each logical session has one terminal and one latest pending slot.

nodes.label: Actual Playback Evidence Gate
nodes.rationale: No arbitrary duration threshold; require playing non-seeking advancement or ended.

nodes.label: Atomic Opt-Out Meaningful-Sample Transfer
nodes.rationale: Turning YouTube off transfers the last meaningful sample and performs no post-opt-out capture.

nodes.label: In-Flight Account Refresh Revision Fence
nodes.rationale: Late cache, network, and capture results cannot overwrite a newer local choice.

nodes.label: Durable Preference Sync Pending Marker
nodes.rationale: Failed account mirroring stays pending for event-driven retry and never blocks local capture.

nodes.label: Account fences and self-only writes
nodes.summary: The transaction rechecks account generation, deletion fences, expiry, ordering, and permits mutation only for the authenticated subject.

nodes.label: Durable lifecycle bounds
nodes.summary: Room creation or membership join bounds issuance below, while finalized room end bounds issuance above.

nodes.label: Attestation issuance preconditions
nodes.summary: Issuance requires verified room token, valid participant session, successful admission, persisted current state, and a non-ending room.

nodes.label: 86,400-second offline grace
nodes.summary: Task 9 approves exactly 24 hours of delayed shared-history delivery for the attested generation.

nodes.label: Purpose and claim separation
nodes.summary: History authority has exact type, issuer, audience, subject, room, session, generations, issuance, expiry, and unique identifier claims and is not a room connection token.

nodes.label: Receipt-first idempotency
nodes.summary: An owner-bound unexpired 14-day receipt for the same client event is returned before JWT verification or mutation.

nodes.label: Task 9 rollout gates
nodes.summary: Protocol, web, RPC, Worker, lifecycle, hibernation, redaction, receipt, fence, and two-writer tests are required before runtime rollout.

nodes.label: Two-writer Recent People rule
nodes.summary: Directional pair evidence requires independently accepted writes from two distinct authenticated users for the exact shared generation.

nodes.label: Worker history attestation
nodes.summary: Private HS256 room_history JWT issued by the live-room authority after accepted JOIN.

nodes.label: Aggregated admission rate limit
nodes.summary: Admission rate limiting aggregates by authenticated participant and room rather than resetting for every socket.

nodes.label: Authorization artifact cleanup
nodes.summary: Successful extension codes are removed immediately, while expired codes and refresh families are removed in bounded batches.

nodes.label: Expired capability event behavior
nodes.summary: An already accepted event stays idempotent after expiry, while a new event with expired authority is rejected and cannot refresh shared evidence.

nodes.label: Hibernation-compatible admission state
nodes.summary: Socket attachments retain the minimum identity and admission fields required after Durable Object wake-up.

nodes.label: 10,000 ms JOIN deadline
nodes.summary: A pre-JOIN socket may keep the room awake for no more than an absolute 10,000 milliseconds.

nodes.label: Pending sockets per room
nodes.summary: Task 10 permits at most two times the signed maximum participant count in pending sockets per room.

nodes.label: Pending sockets per subject
nodes.summary: Task 10 permits at most two pending sockets per authenticated subject.

nodes.label: Fourteen-day receipt retention
nodes.summary: Watch History receipts retain exactly 14 days for idempotency.

nodes.label: ROOM_HISTORY_OFFLINE_GRACE_SECONDS
nodes.summary: One protocol constant fixes Worker issuance, web verification, and SQL acceptance to exactly 86,400 seconds.

nodes.label: Shared bounded cleanup function
nodes.summary: Database scheduling or an authenticated Vercel cron fallback invokes the same service-role-only bounded SQL cleanup function.

nodes.label: Task 10 WebSocket admission
nodes.summary: Room token verification precedes Durable Object admission, followed by bounded pending-socket retention and a JOIN deadline.

nodes.label: Task 8 bounded artifact cleanup
nodes.summary: Global cleanup bounds expired Watch History receipts, authorization codes, and refresh families without deleting durable user history.

nodes.label: Task 9 room-history capability lifecycle
nodes.summary: Signed Worker room authority has mandatory expiry, unique identifier, exact claim validation, and server-enforced maximum age.
